value.name: Asha interprets Daniel's silence
value.description: Daniel does not respond to Rosa's statement, and Asha realizes he has heard it as the opening of testimony he must contest by name.
evidence: Daniel's fingers, which had been resting at the page's corner, drew back into the half-shadow at his side; he did not answer
Asha understood that he had heard the sentence as Rosa meant it, as the first line of the testimony he would have to argue against by name

value.name: Asha presents the codicil and key
value.description: Asha slides the codicil and brass key across the table to Rosa and asks her to recount exactly what was signed.
evidence: Asha slid the codicil and the brass key across the wood until they rested in front of Rosa
"Walk me through every word she signed."

value.name: Rosa recounts the signing details
value.description: Rosa declines to pick up the objects and instead describes the kitchen table, the sequence of the signed lines, and the date and witness line.
evidence: Rosa did not pick either object up; she set her fingertips against the edge of the page and began, in a low voice, to describe the kitchen table and the order in which the lines had gone down, naming the date first and the witness line last

value.name: Daniel retreats into shadow
value.description: Daniel steps back from the chair into the shadow by the doorway, avoiding Rosa's eyes as he prepares to challenge the document.
evidence: Daniel stepped back from the chair until his shoulder met the shadow between the lamp and the doorway
from there, not meeting Rosa's eyes

value.name: Daniel questions the missing witnesses
value.description: Daniel asks who witnessed the rest of the document, signaling that he intends to attack the surrounding omissions rather than the signature itself.
evidence: he would try next—not the signature itself but the pages around it, the absences he could point to in a courtroom

value.name: Asha highlights the missing text
value.description: Asha traces the thin ink and bare stretches on the page, indicating the gaps Daniel plans to exploit, then asks whether anyone else was present.
evidence: Asha leaned over the page and set her fingertip just above the line where the ink had thinned, tracing without touching the small bare stretches Daniel had been counting on
